decls.rationale: Realizes the compositum `M` as a finite everywhere-unramified 3-extension inside an algebraic closure of `F`, exhibiting \((\mathbb{Z}/3\mathbb{Z})^{\ell-1}\) as a quotient of \(G = \mathrm{Gal}(F^{\mathrm{ur},3}/F)\) — the bridge from Proposition 3.2 to the bound \(d(G) \ge \ell-1\).
